title: Dark laptop pose reel with beat words
summary: A dark laptop on charcoal: one word per beat above the closed lid, then five poses (swing-open, two ramped pushes, front lid-open, spin-up fly-in), each with a new screen; brand word and a two-word line close.
use_when: A desktop or web product that wants a premium hardware-style teaser
Five hero screenshots, each worth its own camera pose
Short brand teaser where the screen lighting up is the reveal
Dark brand palette with a single bright type colour

look.type_style: bold geometric sans, sentence case, normal tracking, ~6 % H, white with a soft outer glow, centred

sfx.event: hook word changes on the beat
laptop swings toward camera and the screen powers on
ramped push into a new pose
music drops out under the brand word
closing line lands as music returns

structure.shot: closed dark laptop low-centre, edge-on; above it a 4-word phrase shown one word at a time (last word = product name)
structure.camera: near-static; laptop yaws slowly ~15 deg over the row (0.25 s cells), zoom +0.8 %/s
structure.motion: words replace each other on beats 0.27 / 0.77 / 1.27 s, no in-animation (±0.25 s); laptop yaw easings.linear 87 fr; last word clears letter by letter at ~3.00 s (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: laptop swings ~60 deg toward camera in 3/4 view, lid opens, screen powers on with a warm landscape wallpaper, then drifts
structure.camera: orbit ~60 deg in ~36 fr then slow drift; frame luma lifts ~34 % as the screen lights (human 30 fps study)
structure.motion: swing easings.inOutSine ~36 fr (human 30 fps study); lid passes ~75 deg at 3.33-3.50 s and the screen is full bright as it finishes (~20 fr, human); settle springs.heavy (overshoot not measurable); drift 4.50-6.27 s, slight roll

structure.shot: close 3/4 high angle, screen now shows a cool dune wallpaper, laptop large and cropped right
structure.camera: push-in scale x1.23 over 49 fr with a speed-ramp, speed thirds 6 / 29 / 11 px/fr (human 30 fps study)
structure.motion: speed-ramp easings.inOutSine 49 fr; no element animation

structure.shot: low angle, keyboard in the foreground, screen shows a snowy peak with warm cloud; laptop drifts right off frame
structure.camera: push-in scale x1.48 over 47 fr, speed-ramp thirds 5.6 / 25.7 / 7.9 px/fr (human 30 fps study)

structure.shot: front view at ~10 deg elevation, laptop closed centre-low; lid opens to show a misty blue landscape, then holds
structure.motion: lid opens 10.00 -> 10.65 s, ~20 fr easings.inOutSine (human 30 fps study); screen already lit while opening; hold 45 fr

structure.shot: tiny closed laptop seen top-down far away, spins and flies toward camera, flips open into 3/4 with an earth-from-space screen
structure.camera: object scale 4 % -> 60 % of frame over ~70 fr, rotation ~180 deg; ease-in (human 30 fps study)
structure.motion: fly-in easings.inExpo ~70 fr (approach slow 12.27-13.27 s, fast 13.50-14.50 s); lid flips open 14.27-14.77 s (±0.25 s), lands springs.heavy (overshoot not measurable)

structure.shot: laptop gone; brand word centred alone on charcoal with soft glow; music silent 15.70-17.21 s
structure.motion: word appears whole between 15.00 and 15.27 s (entrance not measurable at 0.25 s; suggested BlurIn 8 fr); held 61 fr

structure.shot: closing line, 2 words with a period, replaces the brand word centred; held to the end
structure.motion: line swaps in on the beat at 17.21 s with the music returning (±0.25 s, no in-animation visible); held 151 fr; no exit

params.hookWords: 4 words shown one per beat; last is the product name
params.screens: 5 screenshots, one per pose (swing-open, push 1, push 2, front open, fly-in)
params.brandWord: product or company name, one word

notes: One shot per cuts.json (0 hard, 0 soft); detector near-misses at 6.37, 8.00, 9.57, 15.10 s look like pose changes (the human study calls them cuts), so transitions are written continuous and a rebuild may cut there. Timings for swing, pushes, lid open and fly-in from the human 30 fps study; the rest at 0.25 s sheet resolution. SFX planned by the glue rule except the observed music drop 15.70-17.21 s. Proposed terms: word-per-beat (words swap on beats over a continuous shot), device-fly-in (object flies from far top-down into pose). Background lifted charcoal with a radial spot behind the laptop, not black.
